creator: krisd.ai
title: duck.ai (DuckDuckGo) gives free, no-account, no-history chat access to GPT-5.6 and Claude models

tools.name: Duck.ai by DuckDuckGo
tools.detail: duck.ai -- free chat, no account, does not store chat history; model picker shows GPT-5.6 (Lite), GPT-5.4 mini, Claude Haiku 4.5, Mistral Small 3, gpt-oss 120b, Gemma 4 12b (approximate, small text)

claims: Free access to 'GPT 5.6 and Claude' with no account and no stored chat history
Caption: 'Why am I even paying for tokens?'
how_to_steps: Pick a model from the dropdown (GPT-5.6 Lite, Claude Haiku, Mistral, gpt-oss, Gemma...)
on_screen_only: Overlay: 'Getting access to top AI models for free has never been easier'

Duck.ai page: 'Duck.ai, by DuckDuckGo -- Ask anything privately', toggles 'Fast / 5.6 Lite', model list (GPT-5.6 Lite, GPT-5.4 mini, Claude Haiku 4.5, Mistral Small 3, gpt-oss 120b, Gemma 4 12b -- approximate), 'Subscribe for more. Try for free' row at bottom (suggests paid tier for bigger models)
A Gartner hype-cycle chart is open on a second screen ('Technology Trigger', 'Trough of Disillusionment', 'Slope of Enlightenment', 'Plateau of Productivity')
cta: Comment 'AI' for the link; save the video

relevance.why: Haji builds with Claude Code on a paid plan; duck.ai is a consumer chat front-end with small/lite models and no API or tool use -- irrelevant to building apps.

implement_score.why: Nothing to do. At most a throwaway private chat for a quick question; the screen itself shows the free tier is the Lite/Haiku class with a paid 'Subscribe for more' upsell.

verify: Exactly which models are free on duck.ai vs behind 'Subscribe for more' (screen shows GPT-5.6 Lite and Claude Haiku 4.5, not flagship models)
No API, so it cannot replace tokens for Claude Code -- the 'why pay for tokens' framing is misleading

gap.what: Liked set already covers free model access (NVIDIA free endpoints, OmniRoute); duck.ai is a weaker consumer-chat variant with no API.
